insights.name: Production visitors
Engaged DM weekly return — eight weeks
Landing → library → scene created
Authoring → saved version → published
Scene created → canvas ready → persisted edit — awaiting v2
insights.description: Seven-day ordered funnel correlated by person and opaque scene ID. Readiness is an observable renderer/map milestone, not evidence a tabletop game occurred.

source.query: SELECT countIf(step >= 1) AS scenes_created, countIf(step >= 2) AS canvas_ready, countIf(step >= 3) AS first_edit_persisted FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.scene_id AS scene_id, windowFunnel(604800)(toDateTime(timestamp), event = 'scene_created', event = 'scene_canvas_ready', event = 'scene_edit_persisted') AS step FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND properties.role = 'gm' AND properties.scene_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, scene_id)

insights.name: Production acquisition
insights.description: Preserved acquisition insight with a 30-day production window. Anonymous history remains anonymous.

source.query: SELECT coalesce(nullIf(properties.$referring_domain, ''), 'direct / unavailable') AS referrer, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS visitors, count() AS pageviews FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = '$pageview' GROUP BY referrer ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 20

insights.name: Gallery discovery → detail → placement — awaiting v2
insights.description: Thirty-minute ordered discovery funnel at visitor level. Includes only gallery-sourced completions. Matched operation outcomes are in the placement table.

source.query: SELECT countIf(step >= 1) AS library_visitors, countIf(step >= 2) AS detail_visitors, countIf(step >= 3) AS placed FROM (SELECT person_id, windowFunnel(1800)(toDateTime(timestamp), event = 'effect_library_viewed', event = 'effect_detail_viewed', event = 'effect_placement_completed' AND properties.source = 'gallery') AS step FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} GROUP BY person_id)

insights.name: New / edit / remix authoring — awaiting v2
insights.description: Successful saves by mode and shader/script kind. Remix saves historically used mode fork; analytics v2 uses remix.

source.query: SELECT properties.mode AS mode, properties.effect_kind AS effect_kind, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS creators, count(DISTINCT properties.attempt_id) AS saved_versions FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = 'effect_version_saved' GROUP BY mode, effect_kind

insights.name: Settled editor blockers — awaiting v2
insights.description: Settled status transitions only. Bounded blocker categories; never compiler messages or source code.

source.query: SELECT properties.status AS status, properties.blocker AS blocker, properties.effect_kind AS effect_kind, properties.backend AS backend, count() AS transitions, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS creators FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = 'effect_editor_status_changed' GROUP BY status, blocker, effect_kind, backend ORDER BY transitions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.name: Runtime compatibility by kind and backend — awaiting v2
insights.description: Deduplicated scene/instance/version/backend status transitions. Counts are observations, not frames or independently failed operations.

source.query: SELECT properties.effect_kind AS effect_kind, properties.backend AS backend, properties.status AS status, count() AS settled_transitions, count(DISTINCT properties.scene_id) AS scenes FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = 'effect_runtime_observed' GROUP BY effect_kind, backend, status ORDER BY settled_transitions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.name: TV/player-view requests and ready views — awaiting v2
insights.description: Open requests are emitted in the GM window; actual readiness in the separate player window. Displayed separately, not used as an operation success-rate denominator.

source.query: SELECT event, count() AS milestones, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS people FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND (event = 'player_view_open_requested' OR (event = 'scene_canvas_ready' AND properties.role = 'player')) GROUP BY event

insights.name: Valid invite → join → remote canvas — awaiting v2
insights.description: Thirty-minute sequence correlated by person and scene. Excludes GM invite generation/copying, which are different people. Join submission outcomes have their own attempt-matched table.

source.query: SELECT countIf(step >= 1) AS valid_invite_visits, countIf(step >= 2) AS join_submissions, countIf(step >= 3) AS successful_joins, countIf(step >= 4) AS remote_canvas_ready FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.scene_id AS scene_id, windowFunnel(1800)(toDateTime(timestamp), event = 'join_invite_valid', event = 'join_scene_started', event = 'join_scene_succeeded', event = 'scene_canvas_ready' AND properties.role = 'remote_player') AS step FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND properties.scene_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, scene_id)

insights.name: Offline and invalid invite outcomes
insights.description: Distinct settled invite availability observations, with failed submissions separate. No invite capability or content is collected.

source.query: SELECT event, count() AS observations, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS people FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('join_dm_offline','join_invite_invalid','join_scene_failed') GROUP BY event

insights.name: Ready player views by device — awaiting v2
insights.description: Local TV/player and remote-player canvas readiness by SDK device/browser. Readiness does not prove play occurred.

source.query: SELECT properties.role AS role, properties.$device_type AS device, properties.$browser AS browser, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS players, count() AS ready_views FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = 'scene_canvas_ready' AND properties.role IN ('player','remote_player') GROUP BY role, device, browser ORDER BY ready_views DESC LIMIT 30

insights.name: Canvas and persistence health — awaiting v2
insights.description: Map/renderer readiness failures plus autosave failure/recovery transitions and preset/create mutation failures. Repeated identical autosave failures are suppressed until recovery.

source.query: SELECT event, properties.error_category AS error_category, properties.role AS role, properties.release AS release, count() AS observations FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('scene_canvas_failed','scene_autosave_failed','scene_autosave_recovered','preset_mutation_failed','create_scene_mutation_failed') GROUP BY event, error_category, role, release ORDER BY observations DESC LIMIT 40

insights.name: Effect save / publish failures — awaiting v2
insights.description: Bounded failure categories by authoring mode/kind. Failures emitted from both publishing surfaces; no diagnostic text.

source.query: SELECT event, properties.error_category AS error_category, properties.effect_kind AS effect_kind, properties.mode AS mode, count(DISTINCT properties.attempt_id) AS failed_attempts FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('effect_save_failed','effect_publish_failed','asset_upload_failed') GROUP BY event, error_category, effect_kind, mode ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC LIMIT 30

insights.name: Weekly engaged DMs — awaiting v2
insights.description: Engaged DM: an effective gm places an object, loads a preset, places a token, or rolls initiative. Distinct people per Jerusalem calendar week.

source.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS engaged_dms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND properties.role = 'gm' AND event IN ('effect_placement_completed', 'preset_loaded', 'token_instance_placed', 'initiative_rolled') GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: Placement outcomes and duration — awaiting v2
insights.description: Unique person/attempt outcomes by gallery/palette source and object kind. Started attempts without outcomes stay separate. Cancellation is a terminal outcome; null rate means no denominator. Retries use new IDs.

source.query: SELECT source, kind, countIf(started AND ended) AS matched_outcomes, countIf(started AND completed AND NOT failed AND NOT cancelled) AS completed_total, countIf(started AND failed) AS failed_total, countIf(started AND cancelled) AS cancelled_total, countIf(started AND NOT ended) AS pending_or_abandoned, round(100.0 * countIf(started AND completed AND NOT failed AND NOT cancelled) / nullIf(countIf(started AND ended), 0), 1) AS completion_percent, avgIf(duration_ms, started AND ended) AS mean_duration_ms FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.attempt_id AS attempt, any(properties.source) AS source, any(properties.kind) AS kind, countIf(event = 'effect_placement_started') > 0 AS started, countIf(event = 'effect_placement_completed') > 0 AS completed, countIf(event = 'effect_placement_failed') > 0 AS failed, countIf(event = 'effect_placement_cancelled') > 0 AS cancelled, (completed OR failed OR cancelled) AS ended, max(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS duration_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('effect_placement_started','effect_placement_completed','effect_placement_failed','effect_placement_cancelled') AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, attempt) GROUP BY source, kind

insights.name: Guest/account join outcomes — awaiting v2
insights.description: Guest/account success rates from completed submitted attempts. No retrospective identification of anonymous visits; unresolved attempts excluded from rates.

source.query: SELECT auth_type, countIf(started AND (succeeded OR failed)) AS matched_outcomes, countIf(started AND succeeded AND NOT failed) AS succeeded_total, countIf(started AND failed) AS failed_total, round(100.0 * countIf(started AND succeeded AND NOT failed) / nullIf(countIf(started AND (succeeded OR failed)), 0), 1) AS success_percent FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.attempt_id AS attempt, any(properties.auth_type) AS auth_type, countIf(event = 'join_scene_started') > 0 AS started, countIf(event = 'join_scene_succeeded') > 0 AS succeeded, countIf(event = 'join_scene_failed') > 0 AS failed FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('join_scene_started','join_scene_succeeded','join_scene_failed') AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, attempt) GROUP BY auth_type

insights.name: Submitted movement success rate — awaiting v2
insights.description: One terminal outcome per submitted move. Only v2 attempt IDs; excludes historically throttled successes. Coordinates and token names are never collected.

source.query: SELECT count() AS submitted_outcomes, countIf(succeeded AND NOT failed) AS succeeded_total, countIf(failed) AS failed_total, round(100.0 * countIf(succeeded AND NOT failed) / nullIf(count(), 0), 1) AS success_percent FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.attempt_id AS attempt, countIf(event = 'remote_player_token_move_succeeded') > 0 AS succeeded, countIf(event = 'remote_player_token_move_failed') > 0 AS failed FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('remote_player_token_move_succeeded','remote_player_token_move_failed') AND properties.analytics_schema_version = 2 AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, attempt)

insights.name: Upload outcomes and compression savings — awaiting v2
insights.description: Map, token and thumbnail upload attempts, matched by person/attempt. Savings use successful uploads only. No filenames or uploaded-file URLs.

source.query: SELECT purpose, countIf(started AND (completed OR failed)) AS matched_outcomes, countIf(started AND completed AND NOT failed) AS completed_total, countIf(started AND failed) AS failed_total, sumIf(original_bytes, started AND completed AND NOT failed) AS original_bytes_total, sumIf(uploaded_bytes, started AND completed AND NOT failed) AS uploaded_bytes_total, sumIf(original_bytes - uploaded_bytes, started AND completed AND NOT failed) AS bytes_saved, avgIf(duration_ms, started AND completed AND NOT failed) AS mean_upload_ms FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.attempt_id AS attempt, any(properties.purpose) AS purpose, countIf(event = 'asset_upload_started') > 0 AS started, countIf(event = 'asset_upload_completed') > 0 AS completed, countIf(event = 'asset_upload_failed') > 0 AS failed, max(toFloat(properties.original_bytes)) AS original_bytes, max(toFloat(properties.uploaded_bytes)) AS uploaded_bytes, max(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS duration_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('asset_upload_started','asset_upload_completed','asset_upload_failed') AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person_id, attempt) GROUP BY purpose

insights.name: Runtime errors by backend and release — awaiting v2
insights.description: Settled non-ready runtime statuses, deduplicated per scene/instance/backend/version/status. Loading/compiling states and frame events are excluded by instrumentation.

source.query: SELECT properties.backend AS backend, properties.release AS release, properties.status AS status, properties.effect_kind AS effect_kind, count() AS transitions, count(DISTINCT properties.scene_id) AS scenes FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = 'effect_runtime_observed' AND properties.status != 'ok' GROUP BY backend, release, status, effect_kind ORDER BY transitions DESC LIMIT 40

insights.name: Web vitals P90 by page/device — milliseconds
insights.description: P90 LCP/FCP/INP in milliseconds. Each metric has its own sample count; different events carry different metrics. Small samples are not a performance baseline. Historical page types were not captured.

source.query: SELECT coalesce(properties.page_type, 'historical / unlabeled') AS page_type, properties.$device_type AS device, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS LCP_samples, quantileIf(0.9)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS LCP_p90_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS FCP_samples, quantileIf(0.9)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS FCP_p90_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS INP_samples, quantileIf(0.9)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value), properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS INP_p90_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = '$web_vitals' GROUP BY page_type, device

insights.name: Layout stability P90 by page/device — CLS
insights.description: CLS is unitless and shown separately from millisecond metrics. Small samples are insufficient evidence. Historical events lack normalized page types.

source.query: SELECT coalesce(properties.page_type, 'historical / unlabeled') AS page_type, properties.$device_type AS device, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS samples, quantileIf(0.9)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value), properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS CLS_p90 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event = '$web_vitals' GROUP BY page_type, device

insights.name: Required analytics property coverage — awaiting v2
insights.description: Coverage inventory, not universal requirements: scene IDs apply to scene work; attempt IDs to operations. Empty table means no observed required events. See repository inventory for per-event requirements.

source.query: SELECT expected.event AS event, coalesce(observed.events, 0) AS events, if(coalesce(observed.events, 0) = 0, 'awaiting instrumentation / no observations', 'observed') AS coverage_status, observed.schema_v2, observed.production_labeled, observed.release_labeled, observed.page_typed, observed.scene_correlated, observed.attempt_correlated FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(['scene_created','scene_loaded','scene_canvas_ready','scene_canvas_failed','scene_edit_persisted','effect_placement_started','effect_placement_completed','effect_placement_cancelled','effect_placement_failed','asset_upload_started','asset_upload_completed','asset_upload_failed','join_scene_started','join_scene_succeeded','join_scene_failed','effect_save_started','effect_version_saved','effect_publish_started','effect_published']) AS event) AS expected LEFT JOIN (SELECT event, count() AS events, countIf(properties.analytics_schema_version = 2) AS schema_v2, countIf(properties.environment = 'production') AS production_labeled, countIf(properties.release IS NOT NULL AND properties.release != 'local') AS release_labeled, countIf(properties.page_type IS NOT NULL) AS page_typed, countIf(properties.scene_id IS NOT NULL) AS scene_correlated, countIf(properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AS attempt_correlated FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$host = 'lighting-vtt.xyz' AND {filters} AND event IN ('scene_created','scene_loaded','scene_canvas_ready','scene_canvas_failed','scene_edit_persisted','effect_placement_started','effect_placement_completed','effect_placement_cancelled','effect_placement_failed','asset_upload_started','asset_upload_completed','asset_upload_failed','join_scene_started','join_scene_succeeded','join_scene_failed','effect_save_started','effect_version_saved','effect_publish_started','effect_published') GROUP BY event) AS observed ON expected.event = observed.event ORDER BY event
